integrity: Analytic proof plus finite exact rational checker; the checker is not an infinite proof and historical originality is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Exact mixed second moments and all cross-pair independence only; aggregate counts remain dependent for derangement partners, no bivariate law or quantitative asymptotics. Historical priority and unrestricted proof require independent review.
title: Fixed-point shielding and a universal covariance law for random permutation commutators
